title: UHRF1P retrogene inhibits parental UHRF1 E3 ubiquitin ligase and regulates T-cell-mediated autoimmune disease and aging
description: To identify T-cell biomarker or potential therapeutic target for human SLE, peripheral blood T cells were freshly isolated from 10 SLE patients and 10 healthy controls (HC) of Cohort #2 and subjected to RNA sequencing.

runs.experiment_title: Illumina HiScanSQ sequencing: RNA sequencing of peripheral T cells
